title: MathFish: Evaluating Language Model Math Reasoning via Grounding in Educational Curricula
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating mathematical reasoning in large language models against K-12 educational standards (MathFish and Achieve the Core). While it includes a standard 'Ethical Considerations' section and briefly mentions cultural competency as a qualitative observation in generated problems, these are not core components of the benchmark or evaluation framework which is centered on mathematics.
